title: Recorded UK imports: tomatoes (HS 0702)
coverage: UK recorded imports from all partners (EU and non-EU import flows); GB and Northern Ireland
attribution: Source: HMRC Overseas Trade Statistics (uktradeinfo). Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

retrieval.method: HMRC OTS API, server-side $apply aggregation; raw responses cached in pipeline/raw/hmrc/
retrieval.notes: CN8 codes: 07020000, 07020010, 07020091, 07020099. Import flows 1 (EU) and 3 (non-EU) summed. Partner = country of dispatch recorded by HMRC. Suppressed trade kept separately. Latest month confirmed by probing the following month. Months from provisionalFrom are within HMRC's 18-month revision window (estimated from publication lag).
